bot-description.description: Bot description / about text as returned by getMyDescription (often contains seller handles, wallets or service ads)

chat-description.description: Description of the chat (bio for private chats) as returned by getChat

chat-id.description: Telegram chat id the bot sends to (e.g. exfiltration chat hard-coded in malware)

chat-name.description: Title of the chat (first name for private chats) as returned by getChat

comment.description: Free-text comment about the bot (e.g. status or context of the observation)

relay.description: Relay host the malware uses instead of api.telegram.org to reach the Bot API (e.g. a Cloudflare Worker)

sha256.description: SHA-256 of a malware sample in which this bot token (and chat id) is hard-coded

url.description: URL configured for the bot, e.g. webhook (getWebhookInfo) or menu button WebApp URL

username.description: Telegram bot username, must end with "bot"

description: Information related to a Telegram bot, e.g. a bot abused by malware as exfiltration channel (token, chat, samples, bot infrastructure)
name: telegram-bot
